text:
marta: Quick postmortem follow-up — we promised concrete rollout safety improvements after the tenant outage. I sketched a compact set of actions, owners, and suggested config. Please review and ack.
sam: +1, we need an automated rollback hook in the rollout controller and a programmatic feature-flag kill-switch.
li: Strong yes. Also want per-flag blast-radius caps (users/hosts/percentage) so a bad flag can't touch all clusters.
ryan: I'll own the observability side (dashboards + alerts). Need a clear set of signals that should trigger rollback suggestions.
tess: Recommend inserting a pre-ramp synthetic smoke-run that gates any ramp beyond 5%.
security-team: We want the kill-switch to be stored in Vault with an RBAC model and emergency audit logs.
marta: Owners proposal: sam -> auto-rollback controller prototype; li -> blast-radius gating + migration plan; ryan -> rollout observability + alert runbook; tess -> smoke-run harness + test matrix; security-team -> vault-based kill-switch access model.
sam: I'll prototype an `auto_rollback` controller and open a draft PR by EOW (Fri).
li: I'll write the gating config spec and a migration path for existing flags, aiming for Tue next week.
ryan: For rollback signals, propose: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m, p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m, error-budget burn > 30% in 5m, and cross-tenant error spike detection.
tess: Smoke-run detail: run canary candidate through critical flows (login, write, read, owner path). If any smoke step fails, hold at 5% and either rollback or require manual continue.
marta: Example API sketch from sam for auto-rollback controller:
```
POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback
{
  "enabled": true,
  "conditions": ["500_rate > 0.5%", "latency_p95 > 2x"],
  "grace_period_s": 180
}
```
li: Blast-radius suggestion:
```
{
  "max_users": 1000,
  "max_hosts": 10,
  "max_percentage": 5
}
```
security-team: Also require an `emergency_off` global flag in Vault with a strict ACL role `rollout_kill_switch` and mandatory two-person approval for high blast actions.
marta: Action item recap (confirm please):
- sam: implement auto-rollback controller + draft PR by 2026-04-01
- li: publish blast-radius gating spec + migration plan by 2026-03-30
- ryan: dashboards, alerts, and runbook by 2026-04-03
- tess: synthetic smoke-run harness + test matrix by 2026-04-02
- security-team: vault-based kill-switch model and review by 2026-03-31
sam: I'll file tickets and link them to the postmortem; will mark owners and dependences.
marta: Quick sync scheduled Thu 10:00 to hand over and lock timelines. Please react :thumbsup: if you accept ownership.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
deploy-bot: deploy started for infra/rollout-controller v2.1.1
sam: noting that the auto-rollback prototype should include a simulation mode where rollbacks are suggested but not executed, so we can tune thresholds without affecting traffic.
li: agree on simulation mode. Also will add feature-flag metadata to track owner, scope, and migration status.
marta: Thanks — Ireated the calendar invite and added the postmortem link. We'll review tickets in the sync and update timeline if needed. End.
